title: WikiVectors · Wikipedia search API for AI apps
excerpt: Short, citable Wikipedia paragraphs from one API call. 1,000 free searches a month.
content_html:
Wikipedia, fresh every hour

Make any AI smarter with today's Wikipedia.

AI models stop learning on the day they're made. WikiVectors is a Wikipedia search API that hands them the right paragraphs for each question, with the source. We tested it. Here's what changed.

Try it. No key needed.

Pick a call, type, and see what the real API sends back.

Find the best paragraphs for a question. Counts as 1 search.

    Want us to tell you when a page changes? POST /v1/watches sends a signed POST to your own URL. See the docs.

    Finds by meaning

    Ask a question in plain words. Exact names still come first.

    Ready to cite

    Every result has the link, the exact page version and the license line.

    Never stale

    Edits on Wikipedia show up within the hour.

    Plain HTTP or MCP

    One endpoint, one error shape, an OpenAPI file. Or plug it into an AI agent as an MCP server.

    Your first call

    Send your key as a Bearer token. limit is 1–20 (default 5).

    curl https://wikivectors.com/v1/search \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WIKIVECTORS_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query": "what causes the northern lights", "limit": 3}'

    Read the full docs

    Pricing

    No subscription. Pay only for what you use.

    Tell us your email. We send your key, with 1,000 free searches a month. Already have one? We'll email you a sign-in link instead, so your key keeps working.
